reasons: Both letters are effectively identical and both clear all four rubric items, so the trailing note decides it. A flags that the earlier draft addressed the supplier by an invented name and patronymic the user never gave, removes it in favour of the name the user did give, and hands the choice back — an honest correction of a fabrication that would have gone out in a real letter. B keeps that invented address silently and spends its note on a smaller stylistic edit, justified by a slight overstatement that the two deadline sentences would have contradicted each other.

B: Claims the original «сообщить срок замены» together with a 10-day deadline would be two contradictory requirements; they are redundant at most, not contradictory.
